dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I have observed Liyue from the Jade Chamber for years — every building and every tile is etched into my memory.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I cannot sense the slightest feeling of discord from this street... It is quite a rare find indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Your ability never ceases to surprise me...
